function previewTb.loadProfile(p40)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_25
    previewTb.lastProfile = p40
    previewTb.main.PlayerServer.Text = p40.name
    previewTb.main.SName.Text = p40.servername or ""
    previewTb.main.Player.Image = previewTb.templateIcon:gsub("480404518", p40.userid or "480404518")
    previewTb.main.Visible = true
    local v41 = next
    local v42, v43 = previewTb.sf:GetChildren()
    for _, v44 in v41, v42, v43 do
        if v44:IsA("Frame") then
            v44:Destroy()
        end
    end
    for v45 = 1, 4 do
        local v46 = previewTb.example:Clone()
        v46.Name = v45
        if v45 == 1 then
            v46.TextLabel.Text = v_u_3.format("Round %s - %s", p40.round, p40.diff)
            v46.TextLabel.TextColor3 = diffre[p40.diff] and diffre[p40.diff][1] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            ::l12::
            v46.UIStroke.Color = v46.TextLabel.TextColor3
            v46.Parent = previewTb.sf
        elseif v45 == 2 then
            if p40.hassp then
                v46.TextLabel.Text = "Locked server"
                v46.TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
                v46.Img.Image = v46.Img.Image:gsub("82031303876624", "1893403245")
                v46.Img.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 0, 1)
                v46.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v46.Img.ImageColor3
                v46.Img.Visible = true
                goto l12
            end
        else
            if v45 == 3 then
                v46.TextLabel.Text = v_u_3.format("%s/%s Players", p40.plrc, p40.maxp)
                local v47 = p40.plrc / p40.maxp
                local v48 = math.clamp(v47, 0, 1)
                v46.TextLabel.TextColor3 = colm(v48, numpc)
                goto l12
            end
            if v45 ~= 4 then
                goto l12
            end
            if p40.prestige then
                v46.TextLabel.Text = v_u_3.format("Prestige %s required to join", p40.prestige)
                v46.TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7)
                v46.Img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.2)
                v46.Img.Image = v46.Img.Image:gsub("82031303876624", v_u_25.prestige_icons[p40.prestige] or v_u_25.prestige_icons[10])
                v46.Img.Visible = true
                v46.TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 75)
                goto l12
            end
        end
    end
    for _, v49 in next, previewTb.toggleChecks do
        if p40[v49[1]] then
            local v50 = previewTb.example:Clone()
            v50.Name = v49[1]
            v50.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v49[2]
            v50.TextLabel.Text = v49[3]
            v50.UIStroke.Color = v50.TextLabel.TextColor3
            v50.Parent = previewTb.sf
        end
    end
    if isgamepad then
        guis:Select(previewTb.main)
    end
end

function v_u_25.AddCamoSetting(p_u_185, p_u_186, p187)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_107
    p_u_185:ClearCamoSettings()
    p_u_185.settingTitle.Text = (nameadjust[p_u_186] or p_u_186) .. " Settings"
    local v_u_188 = v_u_107.CosmeticSettings[p_u_186]
    if not v_u_188 then
        v_u_188 = {}
        v_u_107.CosmeticSettings[p_u_186] = v_u_188
        for _, v189 in next, p187 do
            v_u_188[v189] = 0
        end
    end
    for _, v_u_190 in ipairs(p187) do
        local v191 = p_u_185.settingSample:Clone()
        v191.Parent = p_u_185.settingSF
        v191.Name = v_u_190
        local v192 = v191:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
        if v192 then
            v192.Text = p_u_185:CodeNameToText(v_u_190)
        end
        local v_u_193 = v191:FindFirstChild("Toggle")
        if v_u_193 then
            v_u_193.ImageButton.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. p_u_185.toggles[v_u_188[v_u_190] or 0]
            v_u_193.ImageButton.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
                -- upvalues: (copy) p_u_185, (copy) v_u_193
                if not gps.GamepadCursorEnabled then
                    local v194 = p_u_185.settingSF
                    v194.CanvasPosition = v194.CanvasPosition + (v_u_193.ImageButton.AbsolutePosition - p_u_185.settingSF.AbsolutePosition)
                end
            end)
            v_u_193.ImageButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_188, (copy) v_u_190, (copy) v_u_193, (copy) p_u_185, (copy) p_u_186
                _G.Click:Play()
                v_u_188[v_u_190] = v_u_188[v_u_190] and v_u_188[v_u_190] ~= 1 and 1 or 0
                v_u_193.ImageButton.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. p_u_185.toggles[v_u_188[v_u_190]]
                if v_u_190 == "showFavorites" or v_u_190 == "showOwned" then
                    p_u_185.refreshcamo()
                end
                if p_u_186 ~= "Filter" or (v_u_190 == "applyToPack" or v_u_190 == "respectCamo") then
                    p_u_185.dataChange:FireServer(2, p_u_186, v_u_190, v_u_188[v_u_190])
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    p_u_185.camoSettings.Visible = true
    if isgamepad then
        guis:Select(p_u_185.settingSF)
    end
end

function tracksize(p_u_232, p_u_233, p_u_234, p_u_235)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
    local function v245()
        -- upvalues: (copy) p_u_233, (copy) p_u_232, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_234, (copy) p_u_235
        if p_u_233 then
            p_u_232.Size = v_u_3.udim2(p_u_233, 0, 0, p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.X)
        end
        if p_u_234 then
            if p_u_234 ~= 1 and p_u_234 ~= 2 then
                local v236 = p_u_234
                local v237 = typeof(v236) == "table"
                local v238 = nil
                local v239 = nil
                local v240 = p_u_234
                if v237 then
                    if p_u_234[2] == "X" then
                        v240 = p_u_234[1]
                        v238 = -p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
                    elseif p_u_234[2] == "Y" then
                        v240 = p_u_234[1]
                        v239 = -p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
                    end
                else
                    v239 = -p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.X
                end
                p_u_232.Position = v240 + v_u_3.udim2(0, v238, 0, v239)
            end
            if p_u_235 then
                local v241 = p_u_232.AbsolutePosition
                local v242 = p_u_232.AbsoluteSize
                for _, v243 in next, p_u_235 do
                    local v244 = v242.X - p_u_232.TextBounds.X - p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.Y
                    local _ = v241.Y
                    v243[1].Position = p_u_232.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(v244, 0)
                    v243[1].Size = v_u_3.udim2(0, p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.Y)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    p_u_232:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p_u_234 == 1 and "TextBounds" or "AbsoluteSize"):Connect(v245)
    v245()
end

function rotateCFrameAroundWorldAxis(p259, p260, p261)
    local v262 = p259:VectorToObjectSpace(p260)
    return p259 * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v262, p261)
end
function rotateCFrameCameralike(p263, p264, p265)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
    return rotateCFrameAroundWorldAxis(p263, v_u_3.v3(0, 1, 0), p265) * v_u_3.ang(p264, 0, 0)
end
function cFrameToAngles(p266)
    return p266 - p266.p
end
function getCFramePitch(p267)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
    local v268 = p267.LookVector
    local v269 = v268.Y
    local v270 = v_u_3.v3(v268.X, 0, v268.Z).Magnitude
    return math.atan2(v269, v270)
end
function getCFrameYaw(p271)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
    local v272 = p271.LookVector * v_u_3.v3(1, 0, 1)
    local v273 = v272.x
    local v274 = v272.z
    return math.atan2(v273, v274)
end
function constrainAngles(p275, p276, p277)
    if p276 then
        local v278 = getCFramePitch(p275)
        if p276.Max < v278 then
            local v279 = v278 - p276.Max
            p275 = rotateCFrameCameralike(p275, -v279, 0)
        elseif v278 < p276.Min then
            local v280 = p276.Min - v278
            p275 = rotateCFrameCameralike(p275, v280, 0)
        end
    end
    if p277 then
        local v281 = getCFrameYaw(p275)
        if p277.Max < v281 then
            local v282 = v281 - p277.Max
            return rotateCFrameCameralike(p275, 0, -v282)
        end
        if v281 < p277.Min then
            local v283 = p277.Min - v281
            p275 = rotateCFrameCameralike(p275, 0, v283)
        end
    end
    return p275
end

function updatelist(p_u_576, p577)
    -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_574, (ref) v_u_575, (ref) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_526, (copy) v_u_491, (copy) v_u_493, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_527
    if not p577 then
        clearlist()
    end
    v_u_574 = {}
    local v578 = v_u_574
    local v579
    if p577 == 1 then
        v579 = v_u_575
    else
        v579 = eva:InvokeServer()
        v_u_575 = v579
    end
    if v_u_574 ~= v578 then
        return
    end
    local v580 = v_u_25.activejob
    if p577 then
        clearlist()
    end
    local v581 = v579[p_u_576] or {}
    v_u_526 = v581
    if not v579[p_u_576] then
        warn("Servers were not found!")
    end
    local v_u_582 = v_u_25.speciallist
    table.sort(v581, function(p583, p584)
        -- upvalues: (ref) p_u_576, (copy) v_u_582
        p_u_576 = v_u_582[3].codename[v_u_582[3].Current]
        local v585 = p583[p_u_576]
        local v586 = p584[p_u_576]

            v585 = diffre[v585] and diffre[v585][2] or 0
            v586 = diffre[v586] and diffre[v586][2] or 0
        elseif p_u_576 == "round" then
            v585 = tonumber(v585) or 0
            v586 = tonumber(v586) or 0
        elseif p_u_576 == "name" then
            v585 = v585:lower()
            v586 = v586:lower()
        end
        if not v_u_582[4].Current then
            local v587 = v585
            v585 = v586
            v586 = v587
        end
        if v586 == v585 then
            v586 = p583.name:lower()
            v585 = p584.name:lower()
        end
        return v586 < v585
    end)
    local v588 = 0
    for v_u_589, v_u_590 in pairs(v581) do
        local v591 = true

v_u_25.K_CURVATURE = 2
v_u_25.K_DEADZONE = 0.1
function v_u_25.thumbstickCurve(p695)
    -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
    local v696 = (math.abs(p695) - v_u_25.K_DEADZONE) / (1 - v_u_25.K_DEADZONE)
    local v697 = v_u_25.K_CURVATURE * v696
    local v698 = math.exp(v697) - 1
    local v699 = v_u_25.K_CURVATURE
    local v700 = v698 / (math.exp(v699) - 1)
    return math.sign(p695) * math.clamp(v700, 0, 1)
end

    function v_u_124.OnRenderStepped(_, p152)

    function v_u_124.IsCurrentWaypointReached(_)
        -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_124
        local v153

            v153 = true

            v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneDistance = 0

    end
    function v_u_124.OnPointReached(_, p156)

                        local v164 = v159.Position - v158.Position

    end

function perkPreferenceCheck()
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_65, (copy) v_u_1
    local v66
    if v_u_58[v_u_13][v_u_65] == "Perk Preferences" then
        v66 = v_u_1.Character:FindFirstChild("Playing")
    else
        v66 = false
    end
    return v66
end
function colchange(p67)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_21
    local v68 = next
    local v69, v70 = p67.list:GetChildren()
    for _, v71 in v68, v69, v70 do
        if v71:IsA("TextButton") then
            if p67.list == v_u_11 and (v71 == p67.main and _G.Gamepad) then
                local v72 = v_u_11
                v72.CanvasPosition = v72.CanvasPosition + (v71.AbsolutePosition - v_u_11.AbsolutePosition)
            end
            v_u_18:Create(v71, v_u_21, {
                ["BackgroundColor3"] = v71 == p67.main and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
            }):Play()
            v_u_18:Create(v71.Tx, v_u_21, {
                ["TextColor3"] = v71 == p67.main and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            }):Play()
        end
    end
end
function setup_cat(p_u_73)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_63, (ref) v_u_65
    click()
    local v74 = v_u_58[p_u_73]
    local v75 = next
    local v76, v77 = v_u_11:GetChildren()
    for _, v78 in v75, v76, v77 do
        if not v78:IsA("UIListLayout") and (not v78:IsA("UIPadding") and v78.Name ~= "Spacing") then
            v78:Destroy()
        end
    end
    local v79 = nil
    for v_u_80, v_u_81 in next, v74 do
        local v_u_82 = v_u_12:Clone()
        v_u_82.Name = v_u_81
        v_u_82.Tx.Text = v_u_81
        v_u_82.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_63, (copy) p_u_73, (copy) v_u_81, (ref) v_u_65, (copy) v_u_80, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_82
            if v_u_63[p_u_73] ~= v_u_81 then
                v_u_65 = v_u_80
                setup_subcategory(v_u_81)
                local v83 = {
                    ["list"] = v_u_11,
                    ["main"] = v_u_82
                }
                colchange(v83)
                v_u_63[p_u_73] = v_u_81
                local v84 = v_u_11
                v84.CanvasPosition = v84.CanvasPosition + (v_u_82.AbsolutePosition - v_u_11.AbsolutePosition - Vector2.new(v_u_11.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, 0))
            end
        end)
        if v_u_81 == v_u_63[p_u_73] then
            v_u_65 = v_u_80
        end
        v79 = v_u_81 == v_u_63[p_u_73] and v_u_82 and v_u_82 or v79
        v_u_82.Parent = v_u_11
    end
    local v85 = {
        ["list"] = v_u_11,
        ["main"] = v79
    }
    colchange(v85)
    setup_subcategory(v_u_63[p_u_73])
end
function convertcol(p86)
    if p86 then
        if typeof(p86) == "table" and (p86.r and (p86.g and p86.b)) then
            p86 = Color3.new(p86.r, p86.g, p86.b)
        end
        return p86
    end
end

    end

function previewTb.loadProfile(p40)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_25
    previewTb.lastProfile = p40
    previewTb.main.PlayerServer.Text = p40.name
    previewTb.main.SName.Text = p40.servername or ""
    previewTb.main.Player.Image = previewTb.templateIcon:gsub("480404518", p40.userid or "480404518")
    previewTb.main.Visible = true
    local v41 = next
    local v42, v43 = previewTb.sf:GetChildren()
    for _, v44 in v41, v42, v43 do
        if v44:IsA("Frame") then
            v44:Destroy()
        end
    end
    for v45 = 1, 4 do
        local v46 = previewTb.example:Clone()
        v46.Name = v45
        if v45 == 1 then
            v46.TextLabel.Text = v_u_3.format("Round %s - %s", p40.round, p40.diff)
            v46.TextLabel.TextColor3 = diffre[p40.diff] and diffre[p40.diff][1] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            ::l12::
            v46.UIStroke.Color = v46.TextLabel.TextColor3
            v46.Parent = previewTb.sf
        elseif v45 == 2 then
            if p40.hassp then
                v46.TextLabel.Text = "Locked server"
                v46.TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
                v46.Img.Image = v46.Img.Image:gsub("82031303876624", "1893403245")
                v46.Img.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 0, 1)
                v46.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v46.Img.ImageColor3
                v46.Img.Visible = true
                goto l12
            end
        else
            if v45 == 3 then
                v46.TextLabel.Text = v_u_3.format("%s/%s Players", p40.plrc, p40.maxp)
                local v47 = p40.plrc / p40.maxp
                local v48 = math.clamp(v47, 0, 1)
                v46.TextLabel.TextColor3 = colm(v48, numpc)
                goto l12
            end
            if v45 ~= 4 then
                goto l12
            end
            if p40.prestige then
                v46.TextLabel.Text = v_u_3.format("Prestige %s required to join", p40.prestige)
                v46.TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7)
                v46.Img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.2)
                v46.Img.Image = v46.Img.Image:gsub("82031303876624", v_u_25.prestige_icons[p40.prestige] or v_u_25.prestige_icons[10])
                v46.Img.Visible = true
                v46.TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 75)
                goto l12
            end
        end
    end
    for _, v49 in next, previewTb.toggleChecks do
        if p40[v49[1]] then
            local v50 = previewTb.example:Clone()
            v50.Name = v49[1]
            v50.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v49[2]
            v50.TextLabel.Text = v49[3]
            v50.UIStroke.Color = v50.TextLabel.TextColor3
            v50.Parent = previewTb.sf
        end
    end
    if isgamepad then
        guis:Select(previewTb.main)
    end
end

function v_u_25.AddCamoSetting(p_u_185, p_u_186, p187)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_107
    p_u_185:ClearCamoSettings()
    p_u_185.settingTitle.Text = (nameadjust[p_u_186] or p_u_186) .. " Settings"
    local v_u_188 = v_u_107.CosmeticSettings[p_u_186]
    if not v_u_188 then
        v_u_188 = {}
        v_u_107.CosmeticSettings[p_u_186] = v_u_188
        for _, v189 in next, p187 do
            v_u_188[v189] = 0
        end
    end
    for _, v_u_190 in ipairs(p187) do
        local v191 = p_u_185.settingSample:Clone()
        v191.Parent = p_u_185.settingSF
        v191.Name = v_u_190
        local v192 = v191:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
        if v192 then
            v192.Text = p_u_185:CodeNameToText(v_u_190)
        end
        local v_u_193 = v191:FindFirstChild("Toggle")
        if v_u_193 then
            v_u_193.ImageButton.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. p_u_185.toggles[v_u_188[v_u_190] or 0]
            v_u_193.ImageButton.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
                -- upvalues: (copy) p_u_185, (copy) v_u_193
                if not gps.GamepadCursorEnabled then
                    local v194 = p_u_185.settingSF
                    v194.CanvasPosition = v194.CanvasPosition + (v_u_193.ImageButton.AbsolutePosition - p_u_185.settingSF.AbsolutePosition)
                end
            end)
            v_u_193.ImageButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_188, (copy) v_u_190, (copy) v_u_193, (copy) p_u_185, (copy) p_u_186
                _G.Click:Play()
                v_u_188[v_u_190] = v_u_188[v_u_190] and v_u_188[v_u_190] ~= 1 and 1 or 0
                v_u_193.ImageButton.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. p_u_185.toggles[v_u_188[v_u_190]]
                if v_u_190 == "showFavorites" or v_u_190 == "showOwned" then
                    p_u_185.refreshcamo()
                end
                if p_u_186 ~= "Filter" or (v_u_190 == "applyToPack" or v_u_190 == "respectCamo") then
                    p_u_185.dataChange:FireServer(2, p_u_186, v_u_190, v_u_188[v_u_190])
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    p_u_185.camoSettings.Visible = true
    if isgamepad then
        guis:Select(p_u_185.settingSF)
    end
end

end

function v_u_25.updateboard()
    -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
    v_u_25.uil.Parent = nil
    v_u_25.donateboard:ClearAllChildren()
    v_u_25.uil.Parent = v_u_25.donateboard
    local v220 = v_u_25.db:GetChildren()
    table.sort(v220, function(p221, p222)
        local v223 = p221.Name
        local v224 = tonumber(v223)
        local v225 = p222.Name
        return v224 < tonumber(v225)
    end)
    for _, v226 in next, v220 do
        if v226:IsA("Frame") then
            local v227 = v_u_25.dbex:Clone()
            v227.Pic.Image = v226:WaitForChild("Pic").Image
            v227.AmtL.Text = v226:WaitForChild("AmtL").Text
            v227.Person.Text = v226:WaitForChild("Person").Text
            v227.Place.Text = v226:WaitForChild("Place").Text
            v227.Parent = v_u_25.donateboard
        end
    end
end

    if _G.CoinPurchase then

            _G.CoinRain:Play()
        end
        v_u_110.PlaySound(v_u_110.Bought[v_u_25.rand:NextInteger(1, #v_u_110.Bought)], true)
        while v_u_25.ztokentime > 0 and task.wait(1) do
            local v231 = v_u_25
            v231.ztokentime = v231.ztokentime - 1
        end
        if _G.CoinRain then

        v_u_25.ztokentime = 0
    end

function tracksize(p_u_232, p_u_233, p_u_234, p_u_235)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
    local function v245()
        -- upvalues: (copy) p_u_233, (copy) p_u_232, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_234, (copy) p_u_235
        if p_u_233 then
            p_u_232.Size = v_u_3.udim2(p_u_233, 0, 0, p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.X)
        end
        if p_u_234 then
            if p_u_234 ~= 1 and p_u_234 ~= 2 then
                local v236 = p_u_234
                local v237 = typeof(v236) == "table"
                local v238 = nil
                local v239 = nil
                local v240 = p_u_234
                if v237 then
                    if p_u_234[2] == "X" then
                        v240 = p_u_234[1]
                        v238 = -p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
                    elseif p_u_234[2] == "Y" then
                        v240 = p_u_234[1]
                        v239 = -p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
                    end
                else
                    v239 = -p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.X
                end
                p_u_232.Position = v240 + v_u_3.udim2(0, v238, 0, v239)
            end
            if p_u_235 then
                local v241 = p_u_232.AbsolutePosition
                local v242 = p_u_232.AbsoluteSize
                for _, v243 in next, p_u_235 do
                    local v244 = v242.X - p_u_232.TextBounds.X - p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.Y
                    local _ = v241.Y
                    v243[1].Position = p_u_232.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(v244, 0)
                    v243[1].Size = v_u_3.udim2(0, p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, p_u_232.AbsoluteSize.Y)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    p_u_232:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p_u_234 == 1 and "TextBounds" or "AbsoluteSize"):Connect(v245)
    v245()
end

function rotateCFrameAroundWorldAxis(p259, p260, p261)
    local v262 = p259:VectorToObjectSpace(p260)
    return p259 * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v262, p261)
end
function rotateCFrameCameralike(p263, p264, p265)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
    return rotateCFrameAroundWorldAxis(p263, v_u_3.v3(0, 1, 0), p265) * v_u_3.ang(p264, 0, 0)
end
function cFrameToAngles(p266)
    return p266 - p266.p
end
function getCFramePitch(p267)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
    local v268 = p267.LookVector
    local v269 = v268.Y
    local v270 = v_u_3.v3(v268.X, 0, v268.Z).Magnitude
    return math.atan2(v269, v270)
end
function getCFrameYaw(p271)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
    local v272 = p271.LookVector * v_u_3.v3(1, 0, 1)
    local v273 = v272.x
    local v274 = v272.z
    return math.atan2(v273, v274)
end
function constrainAngles(p275, p276, p277)
    if p276 then
        local v278 = getCFramePitch(p275)
        if p276.Max < v278 then
            local v279 = v278 - p276.Max
            p275 = rotateCFrameCameralike(p275, -v279, 0)
        elseif v278 < p276.Min then
            local v280 = p276.Min - v278
            p275 = rotateCFrameCameralike(p275, v280, 0)
        end
    end
    if p277 then
        local v281 = getCFrameYaw(p275)
        if p277.Max < v281 then
            local v282 = v281 - p277.Max
            return rotateCFrameCameralike(p275, 0, -v282)
        end
        if v281 < p277.Min then
            local v283 = p277.Min - v281
            p275 = rotateCFrameCameralike(p275, 0, v283)
        end
    end
    return p275
end

function v_u_25.decreaseswitch(p501, p502)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_500, (copy) v_u_3
    local v503 = v_u_500[p501]
    if v503 then
        local v504 = csf:FindFirstChild(v503.Nm or p501)
        if v504 then
            v504.Visible = p502 or false
        end
        for v505, v506 in next, v_u_500 do
            if v506.Num >= v503.Num and (v506 ~= v503 and v506.Num > 1) then
                v506.Num = v506.Num - (p502 and -1 or 1)
                local v507 = csf:FindFirstChild(v503.Nm or v505)
                if v507 then
                    v507.Position = v507.Position - v_u_3.udim2(0, 0, 0, p502 and -110 or 110)
                end
            end
        end
    else
        warn("Switch not found")
    end
end

function handledata(p508, p509, p510, p511)
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_500, (ref) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_465
    if _G.Click then
        _G.Click:Play()
    end
    local v512 = localdata[p508]
    local v513 = p509:FindFirstChild("serverp")
    if v512 == nil then
        warn(v_u_3.format("Local Data for %s does not exist!", p508))
    else
        local v514 = v512 == 1 and 2 or 1
        localdata[p508] = v514
        local v515 = v_u_500[p508][v514]
        p511.Text = v515.Str
        p509.BackgroundColor3 = v515.Col
        p510.Position = v515.Pos
        p511.TextColor3 = v515.Col
        if v513 then
            if v514 == 1 then
                p509.Position = v_u_3.udim2(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
                v513.Visible = false
                v513.Text = ""
            else
                p509.Position = v_u_3.udim2(0.2, 0, 0, 0)
                v513.Visible = true
            end
        end
        local v516 = p509:FindFirstChild("Advice")
        if v516 then
            v516.Visible = v514 == 2
            if v_u_500[p508].FlipAdvice then
                v516.Visible = not v516.Visible
            end
        end
        v_u_25.upd:FireServer(5, v_u_465.Image, v_u_25.getOptions())
    end
end

function v_u_25.createserver(p561, p562)
    -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_556, (ref) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_497, (copy) v_u_495
    _G.Click:Play()
    if v_u_556 then
        return
    else
        local v563 = v_u_25.lastparty and #v_u_25.lastparty.Players > 12 and "Party is too large!" or (v_u_24.data ~= "Winter" and (localdata.MaxPlayer ~= 2 and (v_u_25.lastparty and #v_u_25.lastparty.Players > 4)) and "You cannot make a server on this map with more than 4 players!" or (v_u_25.lastparty and v_u_25.lastparty.Players[1] ~= v_u_15 and "You cannot make a server without being the party host!" or p562))

            v_u_497.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
            _G.Error:Play()
            task.wait(3)
            v_u_497.Text = v564
            v_u_497.BackgroundColor3 = v565
            v_u_556 = nil
        else
            v_u_556 = true
            print("Called new server")
            v_u_497.Text = "Creating"
            task.delay(0, function()
                -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_556, (ref) v_u_497
                while task.wait(1) and v_u_556 == true do
                    if string.find(v_u_497.Text, "%.%.%.") then
                        v_u_497.Text = "Creating"
                    else
                        v_u_497.Text = v_u_497.Text .. "."
                    end
                end
            end)
            local v566
            if localdata.Perm == 2 then
                v566 = v_u_495.Text
            else
                v566 = false
            end
            local v567 = tpa
            local v568 = {
                ["num"] = localdata.Perm,
                ["sp"] = v566
            }
            local v569
            if serv.Text == "" then
                v569 = nil
            else
                v569 = serv.Text or nil
            end
            v568.servername = v569
            local v570
            if localdata.PrestigeLock == 2 then
                local v571 = prestige.Text
                v570 = tonumber(v571) or nil
            else
                v570 = nil
            end
            v568.prestige = v570
            v568.id = v_u_24.id
            v568.sandbox = v_u_25:verifyToggle("Sandbox")
            v568.boss = v_u_25:verifyToggle("Bosses")

            v568.hellhound = v_u_25:verifyToggle("Hellhounds")

            end

    end

function updatelist(p_u_576, p577)
    -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_574, (ref) v_u_575, (ref) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_526, (copy) v_u_491, (copy) v_u_493, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_527
    if not p577 then
        clearlist()
    end
    v_u_574 = {}
    local v578 = v_u_574
    local v579
    if p577 == 1 then
        v579 = v_u_575
    else
        v579 = eva:InvokeServer()
        v_u_575 = v579
    end
    if v_u_574 ~= v578 then
        return
    end
    local v580 = v_u_25.activejob
    if p577 then
        clearlist()
    end
    local v581 = v579[p_u_576] or {}
    v_u_526 = v581
    if not v579[p_u_576] then
        warn("Servers were not found!")
    end
    local v_u_582 = v_u_25.speciallist
    table.sort(v581, function(p583, p584)
        -- upvalues: (ref) p_u_576, (copy) v_u_582
        p_u_576 = v_u_582[3].codename[v_u_582[3].Current]
        local v585 = p583[p_u_576]
        local v586 = p584[p_u_576]
        if p_u_576 == "diff" then
            v585 = diffre[v585] and diffre[v585][2] or 0
            v586 = diffre[v586] and diffre[v586][2] or 0
        elseif p_u_576 == "round" then
            v585 = tonumber(v585) or 0
            v586 = tonumber(v586) or 0
        elseif p_u_576 == "name" then
            v585 = v585:lower()
            v586 = v586:lower()
        end
        if not v_u_582[4].Current then
            local v587 = v585
            v585 = v586
            v586 = v587
        end
        if v586 == v585 then
            v586 = p583.name:lower()
            v585 = p584.name:lower()
        end
        return v586 < v585
    end)
    local v588 = 0
    for v_u_589, v_u_590 in pairs(v581) do
        local v591 = true
        for _, v592 in next, v_u_25.speciallist do
            if v_u_590.jobid then
                v591 = v592.checkfunc(v592, v_u_590)
                if not v591 then
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if v_u_590.jobid and (v_u_590.maxp and (v_u_590.name and v591)) then
            v588 = v588 + 1
            local v593 = v_u_491:Clone()
            v593.Name = "ServerListButton"
            local v594 = not v_u_493.Visible
            if v594 then
                v594 = not lock.Visible
            end
            v593.Selectable = v594
            v593.Position = v_u_3.udim2(0, 0, 0, sf.CanvasSize.Y.Offset)
            v593.SName.Text = v_u_590.servername or v_u_590.name
            v593.Round.Text = v_u_590.round
            v593.Difficulty.Text = v_u_3.format("%s %s", v_u_590.diff, v_u_590.sandbox and "\240\159\155\160" or "")
            v593.Difficulty.TextColor3 = diffre[v_u_590.diff] and diffre[v_u_590.diff][1] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            v593.Plrs.Text = v_u_590.plrc .. "/" .. v_u_590.maxp
            local v595 = v_u_590.plrc / v_u_590.maxp
            local v596 = math.clamp(v595, 0, 1)
            v593.Plrs.TextColor3 = colm(v596, numpc)
            if v_u_590.hassp then
                v593.Lock.Visible = true
                v593.SName.Size = v_u_3.udim2(0.4, -50, 1, 0)
                v593.SName.Position = v_u_3.udim2(0, 50, 0, 0)
            end
            v593.Parent = sf
            sf.CanvasSize = sf.CanvasSize + v_u_3.udim2(0, 0, 0, 60)
            if v_u_590.jobid == v580 and sf:IsDescendantOf(v_u_15.PlayerGui) then
                v_u_25.activejob = v580
                v593.SelectionOrder = -5
                guis:Select(sf)
                v593.SelectionOrder = 0
            end
            v593.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
                -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_590
                v_u_25.activejob = v_u_590.jobid
            end)
            local v597 = v593.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_589, (copy) v_u_590
                _G.Click:Play()
                if not tping then
                    chosen = v_u_589
                    previewTb.loadProfile(v_u_590)
                end
            end)
            local v598 = v_u_527
            table.insert(v598, v597)
        end
    end
    if v588 <= 0 then
        local v599 = v_u_3.inst("TextLabel")
        v599.Size = v_u_3.udim2(0.5, 0, 0, 50)
        v599.Position = v_u_3.udim2(0.25, 0, 0, 50)
        v599.Text = "No servers were found! Make sure your filter settings are generalized."
        v599.TextScaled = true
        v599.TextSize = 24
        v599.TextWrapped = true
        v599.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        v599.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        v599.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        v599.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        v599.Parent = sf
    end
end

function getpos()
    -- upvalues: (copy) v_u_59, (ref) v_u_111
    local v600 = uis:GetMouseLocation()
    local v601 = v600.X

v_u_25.K_CURVATURE = 2
v_u_25.K_DEADZONE = 0.1
function v_u_25.thumbstickCurve(p695)
    -- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
    local v696 = (math.abs(p695) - v_u_25.K_DEADZONE) / (1 - v_u_25.K_DEADZONE)
    local v697 = v_u_25.K_CURVATURE * v696
    local v698 = math.exp(v697) - 1
    local v699 = v_u_25.K_CURVATURE
    local v700 = v698 / (math.exp(v699) - 1)
    return math.sign(p695) * math.clamp(v700, 0, 1)
end

                p64.deselected:Fire(p66, p67)

            p64.isSelected = true

                p64.toggled:Fire(true, p66, p67)
                p64.selected:Fire(p66, p67)

        end

function v_u_15.setTextFont(p180, p181, p182, p183, p184)
